manifest.name: POS Self Order Pine Labs
manifest.summary: An addon for the Self Order App (KIOSK) that allows customers to pay using the Pine Labs POS Terminal.
manifest.author: Odoo IN Pvt Ltd

models._description: Point of Sale Payment Methods (Pine Labs self-order/kiosk bridge)

security.note: no module-owned access rules/groups; reuses point_of_sale POS groups and the pos_self_order public access-token gate (_verify_pos_config)

views.note: no views; pure JS/controller bridge, 0 XML LOC. Pine Labs credential fields live on the parent pos_pine_labs payment-method form.

behavioral_notes.observation: The bridge wires Pine Labs into the self-order kiosk via two pos.payment.method overrides and adds no fields. _payment_request_from_kiosk is the override of pos_self_order's no-op hook: it returns super() unless self.use_payment_terminal == 'pine_labs', otherwise it builds a Pine Labs request dict (amount = order.amount_total * 100 because Pine Labs bills in paisa, 1 INR = 100 paisa; transactionNumber = '<config-name>/Order/<order.id>/<uuid4>'; sequenceNumber '1'), calls the parent module's payment_method.pine_labs_make_payment_request(data) (which POSTs UploadBilledTransaction to the Pine Labs cloud and returns the plutusTransactionReferenceID), stamps payment_ref_no = transactionNumber onto the response and returns it to the caller (/kiosk/payment). _load_pos_self_data_domain (@api.model) OR-extends pos_self_order's data-load domain so that, when data['pos.config'][0]['self_ordering_mode'] == 'kiosk', the Pine Labs payment methods on config.payment_method_ids are shipped down to the public kiosk OWL client (they are otherwise excluded by the base [('id','=',False)] domain). This terminal-enabling config gate is invisible to field metadata.

The two module routes are NOT the payment trigger -- the trigger is pos_self_order's own /kiosk/payment/<pos_config_id>/kiosk (jsonrpc, public), which the JS PineLabs.processPayment posts the serialized order to. That base route runs process_order (creating the pos.order in the open pos.session via sync_from_ui), browses the chosen pos.payment.method, calls payment_method_sudo._payment_request_from_kiosk(order_sudo) -- dispatching into this module's Pine Labs override -- and returns {'order': _load_pos_self_data_read(...), 'payment_status': status}. So this bridge plugs the terminal handshake into an existing pos_self_order extension point: the kiosk creates the order and fires the Pine Labs UploadBilledTransaction in one server round-trip, then the client begins polling. Access on every call is gated by _verify_pos_config(access_token), which resolves the pos.config by access_token and drops privileges to its self_ordering_default_user_id.

The two new public jsonrpc routes are the polling/cancel surface for the asynchronous terminal result, both subclassing PosSelfOrderController. /pos-self-order/pine-labs-fetch-payment-status/ verifies the config (_verify_pos_config), re-checks order.config_id.id == pos_config.id (NotFound otherwise), and calls payment_method.pine_labs_fetch_payment_status(payment_data) (parent GetCloudBasedTxnStatus poll keyed by plutusTransactionReferenceID). On status == 'TXN APPROVED' it reads the formatted TransactionData and writes a pos.payment via order.add_payment({amount: order.amount_total, payment_method_id, cardholder_name, transaction_id=TransactionLogId, payment_method_authcode=ApprovalCode, card_brand=Card Type, payment_method_issuer_bank=Acquirer Name, card_no=last 4, payment_ref_no, pine_labs_plutus_transaction_ref=plutusTransactionReferenceID, ...}), then order.action_pos_order_paid() and order._send_payment_result('Success') -- which fires the config._notify('PAYMENT_STATUS') bus message and sends the receipt + kitchen order. /pos-self-order/pine-labs-cancel-transaction/ calls pine_labs_cancel_payment_request(payment_data) (parent CancelTransactionForced) and returns its result. The status/cancel poll is the ONLY way the asynchronous terminal outcome becomes a paid order; nothing here is in metadata.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (OWL self-order kiosk PaymentPage/SelfOrder Pine Labs handler) -- gap #3
behavioral_notes.observation: The client side is plain JS on the pos_self_order public OWL app (3 JS files, 0 OWL components, bundle pos_self_order.assets): a non-OWL PineLabs class (static/src/app/pine_labs.js) plus patches of PaymentPage.prototype (static/src/app/pages/payment_page.js) and SelfOrder.prototype (static/src/app/services/self_order_service.js). PaymentPage.startPayment delegates to selfOrder.pineLabs.startPayment when the selected method's use_payment_terminal === 'pine_labs'; SelfOrder.setup instantiates PineLabs if a pine_labs method is loaded and SelfOrder.filterPaymentMethods force-includes pine_labs methods on the kiosk payment screen. PineLabs.startPayment posts to /kiosk/payment to create the order + start the terminal, then paymentPolling() calls /pos-self-order/pine-labs-fetch-payment-status/ every REQUEST_TIMEOUT (5s), stashing plutusTransactionReferenceID/paymentRefNo in localStorage; a 110s inactivity timer (stopInactivePayment, 90s comment) flips paymentStopped and auto-fires /pos-self-order/pine-labs-cancel-transaction/. This poll loop, the localStorage correlation keys and the PineLabsError notification flow are client logic not reverse-engineerable from Python.

it_architecture.application: pos_self_order_pine_labs (thin auto-installed bridge: wires the Pine Labs POS terminal -- from pos_pine_labs -- into the pos_self_order kiosk self-payment flow via a pos.payment.method override + two public poll/cancel routes + OWL kiosk patches)
software_services: /pos-self-order/pine-labs-fetch-payment-status/ (public jsonrpc; poll Pine Labs txn status, settle pos.payment on TXN APPROVED)
/pos-self-order/pine-labs-cancel-transaction/ (public jsonrpc; force-cancel the in-flight Pine Labs transaction)
(reused from pos_self_order) /kiosk/payment/<pos_config_id>/kiosk -> _payment_request_from_kiosk (start the Pine Labs payment)
logical_data_erm: pos.payment.method -> pos.config (config_ids; kiosk configs whose payment_method_ids include the Pine Labs method)
pos.payment.method -> pos.payment (the tender written by order.add_payment, base POS model)
pos.order -> pos.session (order created in the open session by /kiosk/payment process_order, base pos_self_order)
information_flows: depends: pos_self_order (kiosk app, /kiosk/payment, _payment_request_from_kiosk hook, _send_payment_result bus) + pos_pine_labs (use_payment_terminal='pine_labs', pine_labs_make/fetch/cancel terminal methods, INR/paisa)

client->server: kiosk PaymentPage -> SelfOrder.pineLabs.startPayment -> /kiosk/payment/<config>/kiosk -> _payment_request_from_kiosk -> pine_labs_make_payment_request (UploadBilledTransaction) -> plutusTransactionReferenceID
settlement: on 'TXN APPROVED' -> order.add_payment (pos.payment) -> action_pos_order_paid -> _send_payment_result('Success') -> config._notify('PAYMENT_STATUS') + receipt + kitchen order
indirect outbound: the actual HTTPS calls to the Pine Labs cloud (call_pine_labs) live in pos_pine_labs, not in this bridge
frontend_components: PaymentPage.prototype (patch; route pine_labs payments to PineLabs.startPayment)
SelfOrder.prototype (patch; instantiate PineLabs, force-include pine_labs methods, PineLabsError notifications)

capabilities: Accept Self-Service Kiosk Card/UPI Payment via the Pine Labs POS Terminal
Settle an Approved Pine Labs Transaction into the Kiosk Order (pos.payment)
Cancel an In-Flight Kiosk Terminal Transaction on Timeout/Error
Expose the Pine Labs Payment Method to the Kiosk Self-Order Client (kiosk-mode only)
value_streams: Kiosk-self-pay-by-Pine-Labs: diner confirms order at the kiosk -> /kiosk/payment creates the pos.order + sends UploadBilledTransaction to the Pine Labs terminal -> customer taps card/UPI on the terminal -> kiosk polls GetCloudBasedTxnStatus -> on TXN APPROVED a pos.payment is written, the order is marked paid, and a PAYMENT_STATUS bus message + receipt/kitchen order are emitted
information_concepts: pos.payment (base; tender line written on approval)
pos.config (base; kiosk config exposing the terminal)
organization: (no module-owned res.groups; reuses point_of_sale POS groups and the pos_self_order self_ordering_default_user_id public actor)
policies: _payment_request_from_kiosk only acts when use_payment_terminal == 'pine_labs' (else delegates to super)
amounts are sent to Pine Labs in paisa (order.amount_total * 100); parent pos_pine_labs constrains the terminal to INR currency
Pine Labs methods are loaded to the public kiosk client only when self_ordering_mode == 'kiosk' (_load_pos_self_data_domain OR-extension)
every route re-verifies the pos.config by access_token (_verify_pos_config) and that the order belongs to that config (NotFound otherwise)
a paid order is only produced on a polled 'TXN APPROVED'; inactivity (110s) auto-cancels the terminal transaction
stakeholders: Customer / diner (taps card/UPI on the Pine Labs terminal at the kiosk)
Pine Labs POS Terminal + Pine Labs cloud (external payment device/provider, via pos_pine_labs)
Restaurant / Store Manager (configures the Pine Labs method on the kiosk pos.config)
Accountant (consumes the resulting pos.payment via the base POS session closing entry)
metrics: Pine Labs kiosk tender amounts roll up via base pos.payment / report.pos.order (no module-specific report)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: pos_self_order_pine_labs is a thin payment-terminal bridge sitting inside the in-store self-service checkout: its sole act is collecting the customer's tender on the Pine Labs terminal and completing a pos.payment on the kiosk pos.order so the order can be marked paid. That places it on the retail Sell/checkout primary activity of the value chain (Stabell & Fjeldstad chain / transform), inherited from its point_of_sale -> pos_self_order lineage, and maps to APQC 3.0 (Market and Sell Products and Services) because the operation it adds -- capturing payment to close the kiosk sale -- is part of selling/closing the counter transaction, not treasury/AR (APQC 9.0), which is realized downstream by the base POS session closing entry. It carries a 'network' overtone (it mediates between the diner and the Pine Labs cloud terminal through public poll/cancel routes), but, like its pos_safaricom / pos_online_payment siblings, the value logic it actually completes is the chain sell transaction, so it is classified chain. (Note: the host pos_self_order is itself classed 'network' as the mediating self-order channel; this child does not add a new channel -- it only adds a tender device to that channel's kiosk mode -- so it is read with the underlying POS sell rather than the channel mediation.)

standard_capabilities: pay a self-service kiosk order with the Pine Labs POS terminal (use_payment_terminal = 'pine_labs')
automatic kiosk order creation + terminal payment request in one /kiosk/payment round-trip
client-side status polling (5s) of the Pine Labs cloud until TXN APPROVED, then automatic pos.payment + order-paid
auto-cancel of the terminal transaction on ~90-110s inactivity
Pine Labs method auto-exposed to the kiosk client only in kiosk self-ordering mode
typical_fits: Indian (INR) quick-service / retail self-order kiosks taking card/UPI on a Pine Labs terminal
a Pine Labs method configured on the kiosk pos.config.payment_method_ids (credentials on the pos_pine_labs method)
kiosk pay-each flow where the diner settles at the kiosk before the order goes to the kitchen
common_gaps: INR-only (parent pos_pine_labs currency constraint) -- not usable for non-INR kiosks
completion depends on client polling staying alive; a closed kiosk tab mid-poll leaves the terminal txn to the inactivity cancel
no module-specific reconciliation/reporting beyond the base pos.payment line
refunds/partial captures from the kiosk are not part of this bridge (forward-only collect)
depends on pos_pine_labs reaching the Pine Labs cloud (UploadBilledTransaction / GetCloudBasedTxnStatus); endpoint/SDK changes need edits there
drive_hints: curl jsonrpc /pos-self-order/pine-labs-fetch-payment-status/ with {'access_token':cfg.access_token,'order_id':...,'payment_data':{...},'payment_method_id':...} (expect Unauthorized/NotFound without a valid token/order)
open a kiosk POS (self_ordering_mode='kiosk') with a Pine Labs method and place an order to trigger PaymentPage.startPayment -> PineLabs.startPayment

open_questions: Exact OWL correlation: how the kiosk PaymentPage maps the PAYMENT_STATUS bus notification back to the in-progress payment screen after the server already wrote the pos.payment on the poll.
Behavior when the diner abandons the kiosk mid-payment but the terminal still approves (the polling tab is gone -- does the inactivity cancel race the approval?).
Whether the K-prefixed tracking_number / kiosk receipt path differs for a Pine Labs tender vs other kiosk terminals.
Idempotency of repeated /pos-self-order/pine-labs-fetch-payment-status/ calls returning TXN APPROVED (double add_payment guard relies on action_pos_order_paid state).
